create_autoencoderklwan: create an AutoencoderKLWan VAE model from a WanVAEConfig to encode videos into latents and decode latents back to videos
encode_video_with_autoencoderklwan: encode a video tensor into latent representations using the AutoencoderKLWan encode method with tiled or parallel encoding
decode_latents_with_autoencoderklwan: decode latent tensors back into video frames using the AutoencoderKLWan decode method with feature caching or tiled decoding
forward_video_through_autoencoderklwan: run a forward pass through the AutoencoderKLWan model to reconstruct a video by encoding then decoding the input sample
build_forward_context: build a forward context manager to set context variables for feature caching and first-frame tracking during VAE inference
